description: This is a Java interface defining a storage service for persistent data management outside of typical database storage. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, listing, and deleting data objects, supporting features like temporary storage and key management.

classes.name: StorageService
classes.description: A Java interface for a storage service that manages persistent data objects. It includes methods for data retrieval, storage, existence checks, and deletion, with support for metadata and temporary storage.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves an InputStream for reading data associated with a given key, throwing IOException on error.

methods.name: getTempData
methods.description: Retrieves an InputStream for reading temporary data associated with a specified key.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns metadata for the file under the given key.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns a stream of keys starting with the specified prefix within a module or group.

methods.name: saveData
methods.description: Saves data from an InputStream with optional metadata under an auto-generated key within a module/group, returning the key.

methods.name: saveTempData
methods.description: Saves data from an InputStream as a temporary file, returning the key.

methods.name: saveTempData
methods.description: Saves data from a StreamDataWriter as a temporary file, returning the key.

methods.name: saveData
methods.description: Saves data from an InputStream with optional metadata under a specified key suffix, returning the key.

methods.name: saveData
methods.description: Saves data from a StreamDataWriter with optional metadata under a specified key suffix.

methods.name: purgeData
methods.description: Marks data associated with the key for deletion.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks whether data with the specified key exists.
